title: The ministers of King Dasharatha
introduction: The truthful and upright characters of the ministers of Dasharatha are portrayed, who make the rulership meaningful with their virtuous, skilful and efficient administration. Along with the political ministers, the religious ministry is also portrayed.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 7th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यामात्या गुणैरासन्निक्ष्वाकोस्तु महात्मनः |
मंत्रज्ञाश्चेङ्गितज्ञाश्च नित्यं प्रियहिते रताः
verses.iast:
tasya amātyā guṇair āsan ikśhvakostu mahātmanaḥ |
mantrajñāḥ ca iṇ^gitajñāḥ ca nityam priya hite ratāḥ
verses.translation: The misters for the great soul from Ikshvaku kings of Emperor Dasharatha, are epitomised ones of their tactfulness, adroitness and are always obliged to undertake welfare activities of their king and the kingdom.

glosses.meaning: for great soul, to him, one born in Ikshwaku-s, Dasharatha
always, in welfare alone, obliged to

verses.devanagari:
अष्टौ बभूवुर्वीरस्य तस्यामात्या यशस्विनः |
शुचयश्चानुरक्ताश्च राजकृत्येषु नित्यशः
verses.iast:
aṣṭau babhūvuḥ vīrasya tasya amātyā yaśasvinaḥ |
śucayaḥ ca anurak{}tāḥ ca rājakṛtyeṣu nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Eight ministers are there for that valiant and glorious King Dasharatha, who are clean at heart and are involved in the works of the king and kingdom at all time.

verses.devanagari:
धृष्टिर्जयन्तो विजयो सुराष्ट्रो राष्ट्रवर्धनः |
अकोपो धर्मपालश्च सुमंत्रश्चाष्टमोऽभवत्
verses.iast:
dhṛṣṭir jayanto vijayo surāṣṭro rāṣṭra vardhanaḥ |
akopo dharmapālaḥ ca sumantraḥ ca aśhṭamo arthavit
verses.translation: Dhristi, Jayantha, Vijaya, Suraashtra, Raashtravardhana, Akopa, Dharmapaala, are seven, and Sumantra is the eighth one.

verses.devanagari:
ऋत्विजौ द्वावभिमतौ तस्यास्तामृषिसत्तमौ |
वशिष्ठो वामदेवश्च मंत्रिणश्च तथापरे
verses.iast:
ṛtvijau dvau abhimatau tasyāḥ tām ṛśhi sattamau |
vaśiṣṭho vāmadevaḥ ca mantriṇaḥ ca tathā apare
verses.translation: Two venerable saints of eminence are religious ministers for they are authorities in Vedic rituals, namely Vashishta and Vamadeva, who are the acquiescent with religious matters, and apart from these two some more religious ministers are also there to King Dasharatha.

verses.devanagari:
सुयज्ञोऽप्यथ जाबालिः काश्यपोऽप्यथ गौतमः |
मार्कण्डेयस्तु दीर्घायुस्तथा कात्यायनो द्विजः
एतैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्नित्यमृत्विजस्तस्य पौर्वकाः |
verses.iast:
suyajño api atha jābāliḥ kāśaypo api atha gautamaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ tu dīrghāyuḥ tathā kātyāyano dvijaḥ
etaiḥ brahmarṣibhir nityam ṛtvijaḥ tasya paurvakāḥ |
verses.translation: Suyajna, Jabaali, Kaashyapa, Gautama, Maarkandeya, Deerghaayu, and then Kaatyayana are the scholarly Brahmans acting as religious ministers, and along with them there are also Brahma-sages who are always the ancestral ritual scholars for Dasharatha's family.

verses.devanagari:
विद्याविनीता ह्रीमंतः कुशला नियतेन्द्रियाः
श्रीमन्तश्च महात्मानः शास्त्रज्ञा धृढविक्रमाः |
कीर्तिमन्तः प्रणिहिता यथावचनकारिणः
तेजःक्षमायशःप्राप्ताः स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणः |
verses.iast:
vidyā vinītā hrīmantaḥ kuśalā niyatendriyāḥ
śrīmantaḥ ca mahātmanaḥ śāstrajñā dhṛḍha vikramāḥ |
kīrtimantaḥ praṇihitā yathā vacana kāriṇaḥ
tejaḥ kśamā yaśaḥ prāptāḥ smita pūrva abhibhāśhiṇaḥ |
verses.translation: All the ministers are well versed in scriptures, they shun bad deeds, skilful ones in their duties with their senses regulated. Those great souls are affluent, knowers of all sciences, firmly courageous, and they are distinguished and quiet-souls, and those ministers are true to their word. They are magnificent, patient and famed ones and they smile afore they converse.

glosses.meaning: as per, their word, doers of [true to their word]

verses.devanagari:
क्रोधात्कामार्थहेतोर्वा न ब्रूयुरनृतं वचः
तेषामविदितं किंचित्स्वेषु नास्ति परेषु वा |
क्रियमाणं कृतं वापि चारेणापि चिकीर्षितम्
verses.iast:
krodhāt kāma artha hetor vā na brūyur anṛtam vacaḥ
teśhām aviditam kiñcat śveśhu nāsti pareśhu vā |
kriyamāṇam kṛtam vā api cāreṇa api cikīr.hṣitam
verses.translation: They never speak untruthful words in anger or in greed or for monetary reasons either. There is nothing unknown to them, even a little, in their own country or in the others either, or about everything that is happening or has happened, or that is going to happen, for they know them through agents.

glosses.meaning: in anger, in greed, for monetary, reason of, either
that is going to be undertaken [by others, is not there.

verses.devanagari:
कुशला व्यवहारेषु सौहृदेषु परीक्षिताः |
प्राप्तकालं यथादण्डं धारयेयुः सुतेष्वपि
verses.iast:
kuśalā vyvahāreśhu sauhṛdeśhu parīkśitāḥ |
prāpta kālam yathā daṇḍam dhārayeyuḥ suteṣu api
verses.translation: They are efficient in administration and their friendships are well examined by the king, and those ministers impose punishment even on their own sons, if situation demands it.

glosses.meaning: comes, time, according to [if situation demands]

verses.devanagari:
कोशसंग्रहणे युक्ता बलस्य च परिग्रहे |
अहितं चापि पुरुषं न हिंस्युरविदूषकम्
verses.iast:
kośa saṅgrahaṇe yuk{}tā balasya ca parigrahe |
ahitam ca api puruśham na hiṃsyur avidūṣakam
verses.translation: In collections to their treasury and to militarise their armies they are dutiful, even an unfriendly person will not be tortured, if he were not really blameworthy.

verses.devanagari:
वीराश्च नियतोत्साहा राजशास्त्रमनुष्ठिताः |
शुचीनां रक्षितारश्च नित्यं विषयवासिनाम्
verses.iast:
vīrāḥ ca niyatotsāhā rāja śāstram anuṣṭhitāḥ |
śucīnām rakṣitāraḥ ca nityam viṣaya vāsinām
verses.translation: They are valiant ones with engineered enthusiasm, administrators of political science, clean persons and protectors of subjects of their kingdom at all times.

glosses.meaning: in kingdom, dwelling ones [subjects of kingdom.]

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्म क्षत्रमहिंसन्तस्ते कोशं समपूरयन् |
सुतीक्ष्णदण्डाः संप्रेक्ष्य पुरुषस्य बलाबलम्
verses.iast:
brahma kṣatram ahiṃsantaḥ te kośam samapūrayan |
sutīkṣṇa daṇḍāḥ samprekṣya puruṣasya balābalam
verses.translation: They do not persecute Brahman-s and Kshatriya-s to fill-up the treasury, and high degree punishments will be given on assessing that person's, or the offender's strength and weakness.

verses.devanagari:
शुचीनामेकबुद्धीनां सर्वेषां संप्रजानताम् |
नासीत्पुरे वा राष्ट्रे वा मृषावादी नरः क्वचित्
verses.iast:
śucīnām eka buddhīnām sarveṣām samprajānatām |
na āsīt pure vā rāśhṭre vā mṛṣā vādī naraḥ kvacit
verses.translation: All of those ministers are clean administrators of kingdom, and are in league with each other, as such there is none anywhere, either in capital or in country, a liar.

glosses.meaning: in capital, or, in kingdom, either

verses.devanagari:
कश्चिन्न दुष्टस्तत्रासीत्परदाररतो नरः |
प्रशांतं सर्वमेवासीद्राष्ट्रं पुरवरं च तत्
verses.iast:
kaścin na duśhṭaḥ tatra āsīt para dāra ratir naraḥ |
praśāntam sarvam eva asīt rāśhṭram puravaram ca tat
verses.translation: None with an evil-mind or with an interest in other man's wife is there, and thus on whole in the kingdom and also like that in the capital, there is an undisturbed society.

verses.devanagari:
सुवाससः सुवेषाश्च ते च सर्वे शुचिव्रताः |
हितार्थं च नरेन्द्रस्य जाग्रतो नयचक्षुषा
verses.iast:
su vāsasa su veśhāḥ ca te ca sarve śucivratāḥ |
hitārthaḥ ca narendrasya jāgrato naya cakśuṣā
verses.translation: Well-dressed and well-decorated and they the ministers of King Dasharatha, observe decency in the interest of the king and also of the kingdom, with diligence and with a truthful-eye.

glosses.meaning: of king, in the interest of, also

verses.devanagari:
गुरोर्गुणगृहीताश्च प्रख्याताश्च पराक्रमे |
विदेशेष्वपि विज्ञाताः सर्वतो बुद्धिनिश्चयाः
verses.iast:
guror guṇa gṛhītāḥ ca prakhyātāḥ ca parākrame |
videśeṣu api vijñātā sarvato buddhi niścayāḥ
verses.translation: They acquired good qualities from their mentors and they are renowned by their expertise, and even in foreign countries they are famous for their intellectual determinations in all affairs.

glosses.meaning: from their mentors, mother, father and teachers

verses.devanagari:
अभितो गुणवन्तश्च न चासन् गुणवर्जिताः |
सन्धिविग्रहतत्त्वज्ञाः प्रकृत्या संपदान्विताः |
verses.iast:
abhito guṇavantaḥ ca na ca āsan guṇa varjitāḥ |
sandhi vigraha tatvajñāḥ prakṛtyā sampadānvitāḥ |
verses.translation: Versatile and virtuous are they the ministers and there is none who discarded his virtuosity, and they are the determiners of truce or war, and by their nature they possess opulence.

verses.devanagari:
मंत्रसंवरणे शक्ताः शक्ताः सूक्ष्मासु बुद्धिषु |
नीतिशास्त्रविशेषज्ञाः सततं प्रियवादिनः
verses.iast:
mantra saṃvaraṇe śak{}tāḥ śak{}tāḥ sūkśmāsu buddhiśhu |
nīti śāstra viśeśhajñāḥ satatam priya vādinaḥ
verses.translation: They are capable to keep up the confidentialities of strategies, and also capable to apply their mind even in micro-affairs, and they know moral science comprehensively, and above all, they are gentle articulators.

verses.devanagari:
ईदृशैस्तैरमात्यैश्च राजा दशरथोऽनघः |
उपपन्नो गुणोपेतैरन्वशासद्वसुंधराम्
verses.iast:
īdṛśaiḥ taiḥ amātyaiḥ ca rājā daśaratho'naghaḥ |
upapanno guṇopetaiḥ anvaśāsad vasundharām
verses.translation: Accompanied with such of those effectual and good-natured ministers the exalted king Dasharatha ruled the earth.

glosses.meaning: exalted - [here, not sinless, but exalted king]

verses.devanagari:
अवेक्षमाणश्चारेण प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षयन् |
प्रजानां पालनं कुर्वन्नधर्मं परिवर्जयन्
विश्रुतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वदान्यः सत्यसंगरः |
स तत्र पुरुषव्याघ्रः शशास पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.iast:
avekṣamāṇaḥ cāreṇa prajā dharmeṇa rakśayan |
prajānām pālanam kurvan adharmam parivarjayan
viśrutaḥ triśhu lokeśhu vadānyaḥ satya saṅgaraḥ |
sa tatra puruśhavyāghraḥ śaśāsa pṛthvīm imām
verses.translation: He that most generous one among men, Dasharatha, while observing through spies, and to protect people righteously, and to give a good governance to them, he forsook unrighteousness and became a generous king avowed to truthfulness alone, and thus he that Dasharatha ruled the earth, which rulership is renowned in all the three worlds.

glosses.meaning: to people, good rule, to give

verses.devanagari:
नाध्यगच्छद्विशिष्टं वा तुल्यं वा शत्रुमात्मनः |
मित्रवान्नतसामन्तः प्रतापहतकण्टकः |
स शशास जगद्राजा दिवं देवपतिर्यथा
verses.iast:
na adhyagacchat viśiṣṭam vā tulyam vā śatrum ātmanaḥ |
mitravān nata sāmantaḥ pratāpa hata kaṇṭakaḥ |
sa śaśāsa jagat rājā divi deva patir yathā
verses.translation: Emperor Dasharatha has not encountered either a superior or an equal in his kingship, and to him there are many friends, subdued are his provincial kings and eliminated is thorniness by his own valour. He thus ruled the world like Indra would in Heaven.

verses.devanagari:
तैर्मंत्रिभिर्मंत्रहिते निविष्टैः
वृतोऽनुरक्तैः कुशलैः समर्थैः |
स पार्थिवो दीप्तिमवाप युक्तः
तेजोमयैर्गोभिरिवोदितोऽर्कः
verses.iast:
taiḥ mantribhiḥ mantra hiteḥ niviṣṭaiḥ
vṛto'nurak{}taiḥ kuśalaiḥ samarthaiḥ |
sa pārthivo dīptim avāpa yuk{}taḥ
tejomayaiḥ gobhiḥ iva uditaḥ arkaḥ
verses.translation: In the company of those ministers, who are conducive to the strategies, interested in the king and subjects as well, skilful and efficient ones, he that King Dasharatha obtained brilliance, like the rising Sun along with resplendent sunrays.

glosses.meaning: surrounded by, in the company of
